threads.body: @copilot Update this PR directly. Remove the redundant `private static final String SCHEMA_URL = DbSchemaUrls.SCHEMA_URL;` field from all three `CouchbaseRequestTracer` classes in `instrumentation/couchbase/couchbase-3.0/javaagent`, `instrumentation/couchbase/couchbase-3.1/javaagent`, and `instrumentation/couchbase/couchbase-3.2/javaagent`. In each class, use `DbSchemaUrls.SCHEMA_URL` directly in both the tracer builder and the exception logger builder, covering all six call sites. Keep the database domain owner and the GraphQL module-local `SCHEMA_URL = SchemaUrls.V1_44_0` constant unchanged. Preserve emitted schema URLs and keep this update limited to removing these three unnecessary aliases. Do not create another PR as a workaround, post additional comments, or change the PR description or draft state.

replies.body: Removed the three aliases and switched all six builder calls to `DbSchemaUrls.SCHEMA_URL` directly. Commit: `5f11949a`.

threads.body: [Testing] Non-blocking: this factory is now public for direct access from `RpcInstanceSemconvTest`; both production calls remain inside this class. Add `// visible for testing` to document the visibility exception required by `.github/instructions/java-style.instructions.md:11–13`.
Wondering whey we have a separate class for each semconv. Under what circumstances would we add additional constants here?
